outcome: adverse maternal outcomes (severe hypertension, ICU admission, eclampsia, placental abruption, HELLP syndrome, DIC, platelets <100x109/L, creatinine >1.1 mg/dL, alanine aminotransferase >100 U/L)

adverse perinatal outcomes (preterm birth <=34+0 weeks, NICU admission for >48 hours, respiratory distress syndrome, intraventricular hemorrhage, hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy, necrotizing enterocolitis, retinopathy of prematurity, fetal infection)
cohort: 91 women diagnosed with or suspected to have preeclampsia
finding: The sFlt-1/PlGF ratio correlated better with adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes than any other biochemical marker measured.
